---
title: "Academic Website Template"
format: gfm
---
 

A simple Quarto academic website template for students.

## Getting started

1. Fork this repository
2. Edit `_quarto.yml`
3. Replace example content
4. Run:

```terminal
quarto render
```

## Tips
You can edit the website and see how the changes effects the website by running:

```terminal
quarto preview
```
To stop the preview running use "ctrl+c" in the terminal
